uk.Выбери опору, которую хочешь укрепить пе: Обери опору, яку хочеш зміцнити першою.
Обери маленький крок або напиши свій.
uk.Почти все опоры держат тебя крепко. За э: Майже всі опори тримають тебе міцно. За цим велика робота, і її варто визнати. Тепер сил вистачає на те, щоб тягнутися вище: до справи, до внеску, до сенсу.
uk.Опор сейчас мало, и держаться приходится: Опор зараз мало, і триматися доводиться майже на собі. Це зрозуміло: переїзд вибиває одразу багато що. Не потрібно лагодити все одразу. Одна нижня опора й один маленький крок, цього достатньо для початку.
uk.Нижние ступени держат. Тело, люди, голос: Нижні сходинки тримають. Тіло, люди, голос і порядок уже на місці, і тепер можна підніматися вище: справа, внесок, сенс. Коли стає тісно на досягнутому, це добрий знак.
uk.Умения, опыт и смысл у тебя есть, а осно: Уміння, досвід і сенс у тебе є, а основа тонка. Так часто буває після переїзду в сильних людей: усередині багато, а земля ще не тримає. Зараз важливіше не підніматися вище, а зміцнити нижні сходинки. Тоді верхні знову запрацюють на повну силу.
uk.Ни одна опора не провалилась, но и крепк: Жодна опора не провалилася, але й міцно не тримає майже ніщо. Так живуть на втомі. Одна опора, зміцнена до кінця, дасть більше, ніж потроху всюди.
uk.Где-то крепко, где-то шатается. Это обыч: Десь міцно, десь хитається. Це звичайна картина після переїзду: одні опори ти привезла з собою, інші з’являються тут заново. Міцні опори допоможуть зміцнити ті, що хитаються.
uk.Ты не отметила, что держит тебя снаружи: Ти не позначила, що тримає тебе зовні і всередині. Так буває, коли сил зовсім мало. Спробуй повернутися до карти за кілька днів і позначити хоча б одну річ у кожній опорі.

de.Всё, что я знаю об этом пути, я собрала: Alles, was ich über diesen Weg weiss, habe ich in der Methode «Stufen. Dein Weg im neuen Land» zusammengefasst. Es sind acht Stufen, auf denen sich das Leben nach dem Umzug neu zusammensetzt, so wie man eine zerbrochene Schale mit Gold wieder zusammenfügt. Die Risse auf diesem Weg musst du nicht verstecken. Mit der Zeit werden sie zu goldenen Nähten, und deine Erfahrung mit dem Umzug wird zu deiner Stärke.
de.Мы не ограничимся планом на бумаге. Глав: Wir bleiben nicht bei einem Plan auf Papier stehen. Die wichtigste Frage nach dem Umzug lautet: «Wer bin ich hier?» Wir schauen behutsam dorthin, wo deine gewohnten Reaktionen, Ängste und alten Regeln wohnen. Zu Hause haben sie geholfen, hier funktionieren sie nicht mehr. Wenn du dich neu zusammensetzt und verstehst, was dir jetzt wichtig ist, finden sich die Lösungen draussen wie von selbst.
de.После переезда почти все опускаются на н: Nach dem Umzug steigen fast alle auf die unteren Stufen hinab, auch wer zu Hause weit oben stand. Die Kräfte gehen schnell zu Ende, und ein einfacher Brief vom Amt wirkt wie ein Berg. Ich verstehe, wie das Gehirn auf Veränderungen und eine fremde Umgebung reagiert. Das ist keine Schwäche. So setzt sich das Leben neu zusammen: zuerst die unteren Stufen, dann die oberen. Allein dieses Verständnis nimmt dir viel unnötige Schuld von den Schultern.
de.После переезда всё внимание уходит наруж: Nach dem Umzug geht die ganze Aufmerksamkeit nach aussen: Papiere, Fristen, eine fremde Sprache, die Sorgen der Familie. Für dich selbst bleibt kaum etwas übrig. Gemeinsam holen wir die Aufmerksamkeit zu dir und zu deiner Stufe zurück: was du jetzt brauchst und welchen kleinen Schritt du schon heute für dich tun kannst. Dann wird es im Kopf ruhiger, und es entsteht Raum für deine Entscheidungen.

This is my main and deepest work. One-to-one, just for you, in partnership with me. Ten personal sessions online, in which the two of us move from the fog in your head to a clear path. In the first session we look closely at your goal and where you are now in relation to it. Then, step by step, we work with what is really holding you back, whether it’s fear of the new, old rules or not believing in yourself. Every session ends with a concrete action that you will actually take. Your motivation stops depending on mood and inspiration, because it starts to rest on your values, on what drives you through life and steadily gives you the strength to keep going. We fix the schedule of all sessions right away, so you have a rhythm and an anchor. You can pay in full or in instalments.

en.Переезжая, ты оставляешь не только кварт: When you move, you leave behind more than an apartment. Your familiar rhythm stays behind, the people you could call at night, the language you joke in, the work you were respected for. In the new place much of this seems to break, and you have to put yourself together again, from the bottom up. Like a bowl in the Japanese art of kintsugi: the cracks are not hidden but filled with gold, and they become its story.

en.Это мой авторский метод. Жизнь в новой с: This is my own method. Life in a new country comes back together over eight steps, from “The broken bowl”, when there is no energy and nothing to lean on, to “Here and there — one life”. The lower steps hold up the higher ones. While sleep and a roof over your head are missing, it’s too early to look for your calling, and that isn’t weakness but the order in which everything is built.
en.На каждой ступени три шага. Ставлю ногу: Each step has three stages. Finding my feet — I’m getting my bearings and need information and something to lean on. Standing firm — it’s working for me. That is exactly where our work begins.

The broken bowl — sleep, energy and a roof over your head. Your circle — people around you. I can do it myself — your voice and boundaries. Clear rules — order and deadlines. en.Всё, что я знаю об этом пути, я собрала: Everything I know about this path I have gathered into the “Steps. Your path in a new country” method. These are eight steps by which life after a move comes back together, the way a broken bowl is mended with gold. You don’t need to hide the cracks along the way. In time they become golden seams, and your experience of moving becomes your strength.
en.Мы не ограничимся планом на бумаге. Глав: We won’t stop at a plan on paper. The main question after a move is this: “Who am I here?” We will gently look at where your habitual reactions, fears and old rules live. At home they helped you, but here they have stopped working. When you put yourself back together and understand what matters to you now, solutions on the outside start to appear by themselves.
en.После переезда почти все опускаются на н: After a move almost everyone drops down to the lower steps, even those who stood high at home. Your energy runs out fast, and a simple letter from an authority feels like a mountain. I understand how the brain reacts to change and an unfamiliar environment. This is not weakness. This is how life comes back together: first the lower steps, then the higher ones. This understanding alone lifts a lot of needless guilt off your shoulders.
en.После переезда всё внимание уходит наруж: After a move all your attention goes outward: paperwork, deadlines, a foreign language, your family’s worries. Almost nothing is left for yourself. Together we bring your attention back to you and to your step: what you need right now and what small step you can take for yourself today. Then your mind gets quieter, and there is room for your own decisions.
en.Метод показывает, где ты сейчас и какой: The method shows where you are now and what the next step is. And we walk it with what I have learned as a coach and neurocoach.
en.Ты учишься замечать, что чувствуешь, и п: You learn to notice what you feel and to understand what your feelings are telling you. They show you where you need care right now: tiredness speaks of energy and sleep, loneliness of your circle, anxiety before a letter from an authority of clear rules. Emotions stop controlling your decisions and start guiding you.
en.Чистый язык — это вопросы твоими же слов: Clean Language means questions in your own words, without my suggestions or judgements. I also work with metaphor cards: everyone sees something of their own in the picture. Sometimes it is easier to say “I am like a broken bowl” than to explain everything in order. Your image holds what is hard to see directly, and you find your own words for what is happening to you.
en.Твоё мышление и твоё внимание — главный: Your thinking and your attention are your main resource. We notice the thoughts that go round in circles and direct attention to where there is a solution, not to where it feels scary. We look not at the whole mountain but at your step and what comes next on it. The focus shifts — and you have more energy.
en.Инсайт — только половина дела. Вторая по: An insight is only half the job. The other half is making the new part of your life. For that the brain needs repetition, a body anchor and a small, doable step between meetings. This is how “Finding my feet” gradually becomes “Standing firm”, and the new holds you the way a golden seam holds the bowl.

en.Почти все опоры держат тебя крепко. За э: Almost all anchors hold you firmly. There is a lot of work behind this, and it deserves recognition. Now you have enough strength to reach higher: towards work of your own, contribution and meaning.

en.Опор сейчас мало, и держаться приходится: There are few anchors right now, and you are holding yourself up almost on your own. That makes sense: a move knocks out a lot at once. You do not need to fix everything at once. One lower anchor and one small step, that is enough to begin with.
en.Нижние ступени держат. Тело, люди, голос: The lower steps are holding. Body, people, voice and order are already in place, and now you can climb higher: work of your own, contribution, meaning. When what you have achieved starts to feel cramped, that is a good sign.
en.Умения, опыт и смысл у тебя есть, а осно: You have skills, experience and meaning, but the base is thin. This often happens to strong people after a move: there is a lot inside, but the ground is not holding yet. Right now it matters more to strengthen the lower steps than to climb higher. Then the upper ones will work at full strength again.
en.Ни одна опора не провалилась, но и крепк: No anchor has given way, but almost nothing holds firmly either. This is what living on tiredness looks like. One anchor strengthened all the way will give you more than a little everywhere.
en.Где-то крепко, где-то шатается. Это обыч: Firm in some places, wobbly in others. This is a common picture after a move: you brought some anchors with you, and others are appearing here anew. The firm anchors will help strengthen the ones that wobble.
en.Ты не отметила, что держит тебя снаружи: You did not mark what holds you, outside and inside. This happens when you have very little strength. Try coming back to the map in a few days and marking at least one thing for each anchor.
You have more anchors inside than outside. You are holding yourself up on your own: on your character, skills and faith. That is strength, but also tiredness. It is worth building anchors outside: people, order, a place where you feel good.
You have more anchors outside than inside. Your life is largely in order, but there are fewer inner anchors: what matters to you, what you can lean on within yourself. This is a good time to work on yourself.
en.Опоры снаружи и внутри примерно в равнов: Your anchors outside and inside are roughly in balance. That is a good foundation: one supports the other.

en.Переезд меняет всё: язык, привычки, роли: Moving to a new country changes everything: language, habits, roles in the family and even how we see ourselves. In coaching we look for what supports you in the new world and, step by step, put you back together, here.

en.Карта даёт картину, но не видит тебя цел: The map gives you a picture, but it cannot see the whole of you. In a personal meeting, when we work with your own question and your own goal, the work becomes far more productive and brings real results. A sheet of paper cannot see what a person with professional skills will notice: the pause before an answer, a tone of voice, what you leave unsaid, and what really matters to you. I work in depth, through emotional intelligence, so change happens at a deep level instead of staying a nice plan on paper.

en.Рабочий лист для тех, кто заново собирае: A worksheet for anyone putting their life back together in a new country. Eight anchors, from the broken bowl to the gold you pass on: body and sleep, your people, voice and boundaries, order and deadlines, work of your own, your contribution, meaning and one life here and there. For each one you mark how firmly it holds you right now and what holds you from the outside and the inside, and then where your energy drains away. The map suggests which anchor to start with: everything holds from the bottom, and the lower steps carry the upper ones. You choose one small step for the week, and after a month you can fill in the map again and compare.
